bio: Tang Miu is an independent Thai indie pop artist and musician. He writes, records and produces his own music, drawing on personal experiences, memories and everyday feelings. Each release is part of an ongoing diary — a record of where he was, what he felt, and how he continues to grow.
shortBio: Independent artist and musician creating intimate indie pop from feelings, memories and everyday stories.
